Title: Effects Of Building A Dam
Content: Aaden is managing a large nature preserve. He is studying the relationships between the plants and animals in the area. He wants to understand how a dam in the nature preserve may have affected the population of bears. To better understand the effects of the dam on the bear population, he researches the role bears play in this ecosystem.
Aaden finds a map of the nature preserve before the dam was built.
